name: merge-queue-main
_comment: The required_status_checks list above is a placeholder. apply-repo-settings.sh reads the live list from `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/main/protection/required_status_checks` at run time and rewrites this rule's `required_status_checks` array before POSTing — see the script header for why this MUST happen in the same step as creating the ruleset, and why --apply refuses to create the ruleset without --i-understand-protection-moves.
